code.text: Active periodontal disease (aggressive periodontitis) — may exacerbate glycemic dysregulation and complicate insulin management. Recommend glycemic review and coordinated care.

note.text: NEW Flag raised at Interaction 4, directed to the pediatric endocrinologist. This is the periodontal->glycemic-risk direction (periodontitis worsening glycemic control), the OPPOSITE of the Interaction 1 Flag (flag-diabetes-perio-risk), which was the diabetes->periodontal-risk direction directed to the dental provider. Two distinct Flags pointed in opposite directions — deliberately not the same Flag reused. Travels with the endocrinologist summary (clinicalimpression-summary-endocrinologist).
